description: COMFEN is published by Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory. It describes a simplified interface to EnergyPlus for comparing commercial-building fenestration alternatives, energy demand, peak loads and thermal and visual comfort. Its scope is generic model use; applicability and spatial or temporal resolution depend on the supplied case and inputs. Access is through the public metadata page and its provider links. Software was not installed or executed. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): LBNL COMFEN licence (licence page linked from the tool page).
